title: SALORA: SAFETY-ALIGNMENT PRESERVED LOW-RANK ADAPTATION
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks focus on the safety alignment of Large Language Models, specifically their propensity to generate harmful content (e.g., instructions for making a bomb) after parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
references: Armen Aghajanyan, Sonal Gupta, and Luke Zettlemoyer. Intrinsic dimensionality explains the effectiveness of language model fine-tuning. In ACL, 2021.
